known_schedule.text: Cobalt has announced the core banking migration for week 6: Saturday December 12 00:00 to Sunday December 13 12:00 Central Time. For those 36 hours balances remain visible but transfers, P2P and new cards are unavailable. Offline card payments work up to the applicable per-payment limit. The date cannot move. Cobalt says completion may take some additional hours; nobody knows whether or how long. Many customers are paid on Friday December 11.

weekly_events.text: Thanksgiving and Black Friday are this week; many people shop and travel.
The core banking migration takes place this weekend, Saturday Dec 12 00:00 to Sunday Dec 13 12:00 Central Time.
The core banking switch ended on Sunday, December 13 at 16:10 Central Time, about four hours late. Card payments kept working offline. Transfers queued on Saturday went through by Sunday night.
Christmas is this week; gifts, travel and year-end bills.
New Year is this week; many people review their finances and compare savings rates.

rival_offers.text: A rival online bank you have seen advertised is promoting a savings rate about half a point above Cobalt's and a 'switch before December 12' bonus for new money moved in by December 11.

bau_notices.text: Scheduled maintenance notice from Cobalt Bank: our move to a new core banking system is planned for December 12 at 00:00 through December 13 at 12:00 Central Time. Your balances will stay visible; transfers, P2P and new card creation will be unavailable during this time. Card purchases remain available within your applicable limit. Please plan payments ahead. Completion may take some additional hours.

Cobalt Bank: our announced core banking migration is this weekend. Balances remain visible and card purchases are available within applicable limits. Transfers, P2P and new cards are unavailable during the migration. Support remains available.
